implementation_findings.A: Shared Sun in sparse assignment plus iterative pose/native measurements; solar-off and independent-Sun controls are necessary; no end-to-end joint learned network claim
implementation_findings.B: 36 by 32 degree-five SH coefficients from canonical 33px patches with observed Sun, normal, trial view; own compact frozen teacher; no learned reliability head
implementation_findings.B_identifiability: At most 12 target samples along one constant-subsolar-latitude circle; degree-five restriction has rank at most 11; arbitrary 36 coefficients cannot be identified per fixed conditioned observation
implementation_findings.B_control: Same architecture and counterfactual reconstruction; pooled angular matching/discrimination use
implementation_findings.C: Weighted interval separation of geometric/solar/proxy predictions; not expected information gain; no learned descriptor observations in acquisition score; explicit uniform fallback
implementation_findings.new_close_antecedent: July 2026 efficient lunar geometric/descriptor distillation paper must be cited; no broad first compact lunar learned model claim
implementation_findings.B_identifiability_source: Analytic inference from the declared constant-declination training path and degree-five basis; not a paper-derived performance result
